title: 第五章 抵达白云洲
content_zh: 这启智血灵参，东西是好东西，可惜对方彻是没什么用的。因为他提升到顶了。而且这玩意，也只是中品货色，方彻压根没看在眼里。但是，他没看在眼里，却不代表别人也不看在眼里。提升一级资质啊！众位少年都是目光火焰一般的燃烧起来。这么多武生中，甲级以及甲级之上的，才有几人？“灵参在哪？”康子健道。方彻随手一指：“就在那妖兽的屁股后面十三丈处，那两块大石头下面，挺难看到的，但是你们俯下身子看，应该能看到红色，仔细闻一闻的话，应该也能闻到这香味吧，还多少有点腥气。怎么都这么迟钝？”众人立即看去，果然有了发现。顿时面面相觑，互相戒备起来。而康子健等人想到之前魏子豪的雇佣，刹那间脸色都是难看至极，立即转身，看着魏子豪，厉声质问：“魏子豪？你是什么意思？！”魏子豪心里早已经将方彻祖宗十八代都砍翻了，苦着脸道：“康兄，这个，这个……小弟也不知啊。”“你不知？！”康子健等人呵呵冷笑。方彻有些很抱歉的道：“嗨……这事儿整得，好尴尬。诸位，你们忙着，我去也。”闪身而走。既然已经制造了矛盾对立，那么，还不走更待何时？康子健行礼相送：“多谢方兄高义提醒，日后到了武院，我等必有报答。”方彻心中冷笑，这个康子健也不是什么好东西。这句感谢看似正常，但也是隐含祸心。康子健等人随即转身，看着魏子豪，一个个目光如同杀人利剑：“魏子豪，解释解释吧。想要这么轻易地利用我们，自己拿好处？你想的不错嘛。”另一個少年义愤填膺，眼睛都气红了：“魏子豪，亏你还有脸说给我们一人两千两银子，每人一颗丹药，而且这积分你还不要，满嘴鬼话说只要这畜生体内的苦胆入药，原来如此，原来如此，你好！你好得很！”“你不仅想要独吞好处，还想要用这妖兽积分让我们剩下的这些人再起内讧！”康子健一针见血，咬牙说道：“魏子豪，你这卑鄙小人！”顿时众人一起声讨。眼看着就要打起来……魏子豪的声音急切：“我愿意付出任何代价，我只要这灵参……诸位，诸位……”……听着后面传来的喧闹争执的声音，方彻露出一个惬意的笑容。飘然而去。挥挥手，不留下一片云彩。‘我真是高风亮节啊。’‘这魏子豪居然想要觊觎我苏大哥的遗产，我只是给他制造点麻烦，已经是太宽宏大量了。’唯一有点不解的是，这种地方，连树木草丛都营养不良了，怎么还会培育有血灵参这种东西呢？不过给魏子豪制造了麻烦让方彻很是心情舒畅，而且也从一句话看清了康子健，方彻更舒服。既然你不是好东西，那我未来弄伱就没什么心理负担。想要拿别人当枪，就要有被扎的觉悟。虽然我不在乎，而且是自动揭发的魏子豪，但是你落井下石，在感谢之外多加那两个字‘提醒’，心态就不对。或许你只是无意，但我以后也必须要防备。回到马车旁边。赫然发现，马车旁边居然有几具低阶妖兽尸体，而夜梦的修为，也是从武徒三品，‘骤然’提升到了武徒四品。“公子您回来了？”夜梦浑身抖抖索索，一脸的害怕：“刚才来了几个妖兽，吓死我了，幸亏公子教导有方，临阵居然有所突破。这才……”方彻直接略过：“突破了？还不错！走，赶路吧，你去前面赶车。”“啊？”“啊什么啊？咱们直接功德圆满了，一路直接去白云洲了！”方彻恶形恶色：“到白云洲之前，必须突破武徒五品！否则我把你卖入青楼！”“啊？！”方彻掏出半瓶聚气丹扔给她：“抓紧时间修炼！快点去赶车！出发！”方彻一路快马加鞭，活像是自己背后有狼赶着一般，几乎是不顾一切的亡命奔驰，迅速地离开了试炼之地。这一路的颠簸，让夜梦不断地翻白眼。翘挺的臀部不断地被弹起又落下。不断地发出奇怪的声音。马车轻颠，夜梦：“额！”路面不平连续颠，夜梦：“额额额嗯嗯嗯……”遇有大坡陡坡马车飞身而起又落下，夜梦：“啊啊啊唔唔唔……”身体不断起来落下，发出“砰砰砰”声音，脑袋不断顶上顶棚，发出“咚咚咚”声音。前方，方彻马鞭刷刷不停，发出‘啪啪啪’声音。一直到方彻停下飞速的车，夜梦感觉自己足足被颠瘦了两斤。……后方。范天条和钱三江早就对方彻行为有些疑惑。这小子时不时地心事重重的停下来看四周是干什么？如今方彻离开，两人都想过去看看。这片破山林，也值得这么看那么看？不得不说好奇心害死猫这种事，在任何时候都存在的。比如现在的范天条和钱三江。钱三江先落下，在方彻曾经停留过的地方四处查看——啥也没看出来。而范天条在另一处方彻曾经停留过的地方四处查看——也是啥也没看出来。于是两人再往另一个地方。
content_en: This Qizhi Blood Spirit Ginseng is a good thing, but it is a pity that Fang Che is of no use.Because he has been promoted to the top.Moreover, this thing was only a mid-grade product, and Fang Che didn't even notice it.However, just because he didn't see it, it didn't mean that others didn't see it either.Improve your qualifications to the first level!The eyes of all the young men were burning like flames.Among so many martial arts students, how many are at Grade A or above?"Where is the spiritual ginseng?" Kang Zijian asked.Fang Che pointed casually: "It's thirteen feet behind the monster's butt, under the two big rocks. It's hard to see, but if you lean down and look, you should be able to see the red color. If you smell it carefully, you should be able to smell the fragrance, and it's also a bit fishy. Why are you so slow?" Everyone looked immediately and found out.They immediately looked at each other and became wary of each other.When Kang Zijian and others thought of Wei Zihao's previous employment, their expressions turned extremely ugly. They immediately turned around, looked at Wei Zihao, and asked sternly: "Wei Zihao? What do you mean?!" Wei Zihao had already killed all eighteen generations of Fang Che's ancestors in his heart, and said with a grimace: "Brother Kang, this, this... I don't even know." "You don't know?!" Kang Zijian and others sneered.Fang Che said apologetically: "Hey... this is so embarrassing. Everyone, you are busy, I will go." He walked away.Now that contradictions have been created, how long will it take before we leave?Kang Zijian bowed and sent him off: "Thank you, Brother Fang Gaoyi, for reminding me. I will definitely repay you when I get to the martial arts academy in the future." Fang Che sneered in his heart, this Kang Zijian is not a good person.This thank you seems normal, but it also contains evil intentions.Kang Zijian and others immediately turned around and looked at Wei Zihao, their eyes like murderous swords: "Wei Zihao, please explain. You want to take advantage of us so easily and get benefits for yourself? You think well." Another young man was filled with indignation and his eyes were red with anger: "Wei Zihao, you have the nerve to say give each of us two thousand taels of silver and a pill, and thisYou don't want the points, and you're talking nonsense, so long as the gall inside this beast is used as medicine, that's it, that's it, you're so good!" "You not only want to take advantage of it, but you also want to use these monster points to start another internal conflict!" Kang Zijian hit the nail on the head and said through gritted teeth, "Wei Zihao, you despicable villain!" Everyone immediately condemned you.A fight was about to begin... Wei Zihao's voice was urgent: "I'm willing to pay any price, I just want this spiritual ginseng... Everyone, everyone..."... Listening to the noisy arguments coming from behind, Fang Che showed a pleasant smile.Float away.Wave your hands and leave no cloud behind.‘I’m such a noble person.’ ‘This Wei Zihao actually wants to covet the inheritance of my brother Su. I just caused some trouble for him, which is already too magnanimous.’ The only thing that’s a bit puzzling is that in a place like this, where even the trees and grass are malnourished, how can something like Blood Spirit Ginseng be cultivated?However, causing trouble for Wei Zihao made Fang Che feel very comfortable, and he also saw Kang Zijian clearly from one sentence, making Fang Che even more comfortable.Since you are not a good person, I won’t have any psychological burden in making trouble in the future.If you want to use others as a gun, you must be prepared to be stabbed.Although I don't care, and it was Wei Zihao who took the initiative to expose me, but you are adding those two words of 'reminder' to the thank you to add insult to injury, and your mentality is wrong.Maybe you just didn't mean it, but I have to be careful in the future.Return to the carriage.Shockingly, he discovered that there were several corpses of low-level monsters beside the carriage, and Ye Meng's cultivation level had 'suddenly' improved from the third-grade martial artist to the fourth-grade martial artist."Young master, are you back?" Ye Meng trembled all over, with a look of fear on his face: "A few monsters came just now, which scared me to death. Fortunately, the master taught me well, and I actually made a breakthrough before the battle. Then..." Fang Che skipped it directly: "Breakthrough? Not bad! Come on, hurry up, you go ahead and catch the car." "Ah?" "Ah what? Let's complete our merits and go directly to Baiyunzhou all the way.Fang Che looked evil and said, "You must break through to the fifth level of martial arts! Otherwise, I will sell you to a brothel!""Ah?"Fang Che took out a half bottle of Qi Gathering Pill and threw it to her: "Hurry up and hurry up! Let's go!"Fang Che rushed as if there was a wolf behind him and left the trial area quickly.The bumps along the way made Ye Meng roll her eyes repeatedly.Her pert buttocks were constantly being bounced up and down.Keep making strange noises.The carriage bumped lightly, and the night dream said: "Uh!" The road was uneven and bumped continuously. The night dream said: "Uh uh uh uh uh uh..." When encountering a steep slope, the carriage flew up and fell down. The night dream said: "Ahhhhhhhhhhh..." The body kept rising and falling, making a "bang bang bang" sound, and the head kept pushing against the ceiling, making a "dong dong dong dong" sound.Ahead, Fang Che's riding whip kept whipping, making a 'pop, pop, pop' sound.Until Fang Che stopped the speeding car, Ye Meng felt that he had lost two pounds.……rear.Fan Tiantiao and Qian Sanjiang had long been confused about Fang Che's behavior.What is this kid doing when he stops and looks around thoughtfully from time to time?Now that Fang Che left, both of them wanted to go and have a look.Is this ruined mountain forest worth seeing this and that?I have to say that curiosity kills the cat. It happens at any time.For example, the current Fan Tiantiao and Qian Sanjiang.Qian Sanjiang landed first and looked around at the place where Fang Che had stayed - and saw nothing.Fan Tiantiao looked around at another place where Fang Che had stayed - and saw nothing.So the two of them went to another place.
